title: लोनार झील अचानक गुलाबी क्यों हो गई? 🩷
cover_text: लोनार झील कुछ दिनों में *गुलाबी* हो गई!

cover.prompt: A near-perfectly round crater lake filled with vivid bubblegum-pink water in Maharashtra India, the pink circle huge and sharp in the lower two-thirds of the frame, steep green forested rim and dry brown plain around it, calm deep-blue clear sky across the top third, bright midday sun, aerial shot

source: Geological Survey of India; Agharkar Research Institute 2020 report on Haloarchaea in Lonar; Encyclopaedia Britannica (Lonar Lake)

fact_check.weak: Novelty: the 2020 pink lake was widely covered, and the 'new study' is from 2010, so it isn't really new. The hook question is also repeated back to back.

hook_score.why: Short, shocking and visual, and it flows straight into 'ये है लोनार झील'. 'Overnight' is slightly loose, since the change took a few days.
hook_score.was: दो हज़ार बीस में ये झील कुछ ही दिनों में गुलाबी क्यों हो गई?
